title: "sem"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lavaan)
```

A linear regression is an SEM with one equation and no latent variables

```{r}
set.seed(2026)
n <- 500
dat <- tibble(
  age = rnorm(n, 50, 10),
  bmi = 22 + 0.05 * age + rnorm(n, sd = 3),
  sbp = 90 + 0.5 * age + 1.2 * bmi + rnorm(n, sd = 10)
)

fit_lm <- lm(sbp ~ age + bmi, data = dat)
coef(fit_lm)
sigma(fit_lm)^2
```

The same model in lavaan

```{r}
model <- "sbp ~ age + bmi"

fit_sem <- sem(model, data = dat, meanstructure = TRUE)
parameterEstimates(fit_sem) |> as_tibble()
```

```{r}
lavInspect(fit_sem, "free")
```
